notes: The four original scenes are preserved verbatim, in chronological order. Target 90–180 seconds; measured audio and media QA are authoritative.

scenes.text: At sunrise, the council pointed at Ember. Nobody believed his story, and they sent the little fox away. Smoke still covered the village. The council refused to look at the blue feather.
scenes.direction: Sunrise reveals destroyed village; Ember stands before the council.

scenes.text: Please, just listen. Moss saw it too. The feather moved before thunder, when the sky was clear.
scenes.direction: Ember pleads with villagers, paws open, eyes wide.

scenes.text: The guards shut the wooden gate. Ember's teal scarf caught on a latch, and he pulled it loose before turning away.
scenes.direction: Gate slams; fox rescues scarf and backs away.

scenes.text: I did not start that fire! If nobody will listen, I will find the truth myself. I will bring back something they cannot deny.
scenes.direction: Fox gathers courage, then walks toward wooded slope.

scenes.text: Moss waited beneath an ancient oak. His weathered shell was covered in pale gray ash, but his eyes were gentle.
scenes.direction: Tortoise takes measured steps into forest clearing.

scenes.text: I argued for you. They are frightened, Ember. Frightened creatures sometimes forget how to listen.
scenes.direction: Moss nods sadly and faces the fox.

scenes.text: The feather led us to a bell. But there is no bell near the burned river. How can that be?
scenes.direction: Ember picks his way across branches, searching the treetops.

scenes.text: The oldest trees keep their own witnesses. Follow the sound that does not belong to the wind. Listen closely. The answer will not shout.
scenes.direction: Elder tortoise tests the earth, pauses to hear distant ringing.

scenes.text: A single chime passed through the trees. Ember followed it beyond the twisted roots, where a winged shadow crossed the morning sky.
scenes.direction: Camera rises above branches as fox looks upward.

scenes.text: Who is there? I am not your enemy! I only want to know who sent the feather.
scenes.direction: Fox stands still and calls to the unseen owl.

scenes.text: Deep in the woods, a voice called Ember by name. It came from a white-eyed owl. She opened blue-gray wings flecked with silver and watched him without blinking.
scenes.direction: Owl Luma glides down and lands, controlled wing motion.

scenes.text: You know my name? Then you must know about the fire. Tell me what happened. Please.
scenes.direction: Fox approaches with surprise and fear; pauses under the branch.

scenes.text: The owl looked toward the village. The distant bell sounded again. She knew something terrible, and Ember was afraid to ask.
scenes.direction: Camera pushes toward Luma's eyes, ending on an unresolved warning.
